mentions.name: Video Puzzle
mentions.description: A daily puzzle game where players unscramble videos, published at videopuzzle.org. It has been running for one year, with 365 videos to unscramble.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Been continuing to work on my daily puzzle game: https://videopuzzle.org

Yesterday was the one year anniversary, meaning there are 365 videos to unscramble. :)
